####################################################################################################
Purpose of script: To write the slurm sh files for each model
####################################################################################################

# Set up
```{r}
rm(list = ls())
source("../00_pck.R")
source("fun_brms_mod.R")

pathogen <- "multi_men"
dose <- if(pathogen %in% c("vzv", "measl", "mumps", "rubel", 
                           "hav", "multi_mmr-vzv", "multi_mmr")) "v1" else "vl"
dirs$outputs <- glue("../outputs/perpathogen/{pathogen}")
```

# Read formulas 
```{r}
l_formula <- readRDS(file = glue("{dirs$outputs}/formula_brms_{pathogen}_l.rds"))
play_fo <- l_formula[[3]]
```

# Read data
```{r}
play_dat <- readRDS(file = glue("{dirs$outputs}/data_brms_{pathogen}_{dose}_s08_kgc_1.rds"))
unique(play_dat$country)

play_dat %>%
  select(starts_with("imm_val_s1"), starts_with("censored"), sex, age, study, country, center, 
         rct_group, vac_conc, reg_6, pi_vac_week_v1, time_v1_v2, time_v2_v3, time_vl_s1) %>%
  summarize(across(everything(), n_distinct))
```

# Run the model
```{r}
play_mod <- brm(
  formula = play_fo,
  data = play_dat, family = Gamma(link = "log"),
  warmup = 1000, iter = 3000, chains = 1,
  init = 0, control = list(adapt_delta = 0.95))

conditional_effects(play_mod)
play_mod

stancode(play_mod)
```


# Loop over quick
```{r}
sapply(c("rota", "vzv", "measl", "mumps", "rubel", "hav", "men", "strep", "hib", "polio", "ipv", "opv",
         "dipht", "dtpa", "dtpw", "tetan", "pertu", "hbv"), function(pathogen) {
#sapply(c("multi_men", "multi_pertu", "multi_polio", "multi_ipv", "multi_opv", "multi_strep"), function(pathogen) {
  dirs$outputs <- glue("../outputs/perpathogen/{pathogen}")
  l_formula <- readRDS(file = glue("{dirs$outputs}/formula_brms_{pathogen}_l.rds"))
  dose <- if(pathogen %in% c("vzv", "measl", "mumps", "rubel", "hav")) "v1" else "vl"
  play_fo <- l_formula[[glue("bm{dose}_s08_dfkgc3_{pathogen}_cs2i_reg_6_kgc_3")]]
  play_dat <- readRDS(file = glue("{dirs$outputs}/data_brms_{pathogen}_{dose}_s08_kgc_1.rds")) %>%
    summarize(across(all_of(all.vars(play_fo)), n_distinct))
    #summarize(across(all_of(c("vac_conc", "vac_name_v1")), n_distinct))
  return(play_dat)
}, simplify = FALSE) %>%
  bind_rows(.id = "pat")
  
pathogen = "hbv"
dirs$outputs <- glue("../outputs/perpathogen/{pathogen}")
dose <- if(pathogen %in% c("vzv", "measl", "mumps", "rubel", "hav")) "v1" else "vl"
readRDS(file = glue("{dirs$outputs}/data_brms_{pathogen}_{dose}_s08.rds")) %>%
 distinct(vac_name_v1, vac_conc, vac_conc_n)
```

## TESTSSS

# Testing if rotavirus 
```{r}
mod_photo = brm(
  formula = imm_val_s1 | cens(censored) ~ 1 + sex + age + (1 | study) + (1 | 
    study:country:center:rct_group) + vac_conc + vac_name_v1 + 
    time_vl_s1 + s(vac_week_v1, reg_6a, bs = 'fs', xt = list(bs = 'cc')),
  data = play_dat, family = Gamma(link = "log"),
  warmup = 1000, iter = 3000, chains = 1,
  init = 0, control = list(adapt_delta = 0.95), save_all_pars = TRUE)

mod_photo_climate = brm(
  formula = imm_val_s1 | cens(censored) ~ 1 + sex + age + (1 | study) + (1 | 
    study:country:center:rct_group) + vac_conc + vac_name_v1 + 
    time_vl_s1 + s(vac_week_v1, reg_6a, bs = 'fs', xt = list(bs = 'cc')) +
    s(vac_week_v1, kgc_3, bs = 'fs', xt = list(bs = 'cc')),
  data = play_dat, family = Gamma(link = "log"),
  warmup = 1000, iter = 3000, chains = 1,
  init = 0, control = list(adapt_delta = 0.95), save_all_pars = TRUE)

waic(mod_photo, mod_photo_climate)

loo(mod_photo, mod_photo_climate)
mod_photo
mod_photo_climate

conditional_smooths(mod_photo)
conditional_smooths(mod_photo_climate)

waic(mod_photo_climate, bmv1_s08_varicella_cs2i_kgc_3_reg_6a_dfkgc3)
mod_photo_climate
```













# Run the model
```{r}
play_mod_nothing <- brm(
  formula = imm_val_s1 ~ 1 + sex + age + (1 | study) + (1 | 
    study:country:center:rct_group) + time_v1_v2 + 
    time_v2_v3 + time_vl_s1,
  data = play_dat, family = gaussian(link = "log"),
  warmup = 1000, iter = 3000, chains = 1,
  init = 0, control = list(adapt_delta = 0.95))

play_mod_cens <- brm(
  formula = imm_val_s1 | cens(censored) ~ 1 + sex + age + (1 | study) + (1 | 
    study:country:center:rct_group) + time_v1_v2 + 
    time_v2_v3 + time_vl_s1,
  data = play_dat, family = gaussian(link = "log"),
  warmup = 1000, iter = 3000, chains = 1,
  init = 0, control = list(adapt_delta = 0.95))

play_mod_nothing
play_mod_cens

waic(play_mod_nothing, play_mod_cens)

# does the censoring matters? 
play_dat_mi <- play_dat %>%
  mutate(imm_val_s1 = case_when(censored == 0 ~ imm_val_s1, .default = NA))

play_mod_mi <- brm(
  formula = imm_val_s1 | mi() ~ 1 + sex + age + (1 | study) + (1 | 
    study:country:center:rct_group) + time_v1_v2 + 
    time_v2_v3 + time_vl_s1,
  data = play_dat_mi, family = gaussian(link = "log"),
  warmup = 1000, iter = 3000, chains = 1,
  init = 0, control = list(adapt_delta = 0.95))

# play_mod_mi_trunc <- brm(
#   formula = imm_val_s1 | mi() + trunc(4) ~ 1 + sex + age + (1 | study) + (1 | 
#     study:country:center:rct_group) + time_v1_v2 + 
#     time_v2_v3 + time_vl_s1,
#   data = play_dat_mi, family = gaussian(link = "log"),
#   warmup = 1000, iter = 3000, chains = 1,
#   init = 0, control = list(adapt_delta = 0.95))


play_mod_nothing_gamma <- brm(
  formula = imm_val_s1 ~ 1 + sex + age + (1 | study) + (1 | 
    study:country:center:rct_group) + time_v1_v2 + 
    time_v2_v3 + time_vl_s1,
  data = play_dat, family = Gamma(link = "log"),
  warmup = 1000, iter = 3000, chains = 1,
  init = 0, control = list(adapt_delta = 0.95))


conditional_effects(play_mod)
play_mod

stancode(play_mod)
stancode(play_mod_mi)
arrange(play_dat, imm_val_s1)

summary(play_mod_nothing)$fixed
summary(play_mod_cens)$fixed
summary(play_mod_mi)$fixed

waic(play_mod_nothing, play_mod_cens, play_mod_mi)

p1 <-
  play_dat %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = imm_val_s1)) +
  geom_histogram() +
  scale_x_continuous(trans = "log", limits = c(1, 10^6)) + 
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1700)) + 
  labs(subtitle = "Data")

set.seed(25)
p2 <-
  predict(play_mod_nothing,
          summary = F,
          ndraws = 1) %>% 
  data.frame() %>% 
  mutate(sim = 1:n()) %>% 
  pivot_longer(-sim)  %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = value)) +
  geom_histogram() +
  scale_x_continuous(trans = "log", limits = c(1, 10^6)) + 
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1700)) + 
  labs(subtitle = "Simulation: no censoring") +
  facet_wrap(~ sim, ncol = 1, labeller = label_both)

p3 <-
  predict(play_mod_cens,
          summary = F,
          ndraws = 1) %>% 
  data.frame() %>% 
  mutate(sim = 1:n()) %>% 
  pivot_longer(-sim)  %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = value)) +
  geom_histogram() +
  scale_x_continuous(trans = "log", limits = c(1, 10^6)) + 
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1700)) + 
  labs(subtitle = "Simulation: censoring") +
  facet_wrap(~ sim, ncol = 1, labeller = label_both)

p4 <-
  predict(play_mod_mi,
          summary = F,
          ndraws = 1) %>% 
  data.frame() %>% 
  mutate(sim = 1:n()) %>% 
  pivot_longer(-sim)  %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = value)) +
  geom_histogram() +
  scale_x_continuous(trans = "log", limits = c(1, 10^6)) + 
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 850)) + 
  labs(subtitle = "Simulation: missing") +
  facet_wrap(~ sim, ncol = 1, labeller = label_both)

p5 <-
  predict(play_mod_mi_trunc,
          summary = F,
          ndraws = 1) %>% 
  data.frame() %>% 
  mutate(sim = 1:n()) %>% 
  pivot_longer(-sim)  %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = value)) +
  geom_histogram() +
  scale_x_continuous(trans = "log", limits = c(1, 10^6)) + 
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 850)) + 
  labs(subtitle = "Simulation: missing truncated (not converging)") +
  facet_wrap(~ sim, ncol = 1, labeller = label_both)

p6 <-
  predict(play_mod_nothing_gamma,
          summary = F,
          ndraws = 1) %>% 
  data.frame() %>% 
  mutate(sim = 1:n()) %>% 
  pivot_longer(-sim)  %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = value)) +
  geom_histogram() +
  scale_x_continuous(trans = "log", limits = c(1, 10^6)) + 
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 850)) + 
  labs(subtitle = "Simulation: nothing with gamma") +
  facet_wrap(~ sim, ncol = 1, labeller = label_both)

p1/p2/p3/p4/p5/p6

bayes_R2(play_mod_nothing)
play_mod_nothing$f
bayes_R2(play_mod_cens)
```





# Run the model
```{r}
play_mod <- brm(
  formula = bf(imm_val_s1_anti_menc | cens(censored_anti_menc) ~ 1 + sex + age + vac_conc + (1 | study) + (1 | study:country:center:rct_group) + 
                 reg_3 * cos(0.1208 * vac_week_v1) + reg_3 * sin(0.1208 * vac_week_v1) + time_v1_v2 + time_v2_v3 + time_vl_s1) + 
            bf(imm_val_s1_anti_mena | cens(censored_anti_mena) ~ 1 + sex + age + vac_conc + (1 | study) + (1 | study:country:center:rct_group) + 
                 reg_3 * cos(0.1208 * vac_week_v1) + reg_3 * sin(0.1208 * vac_week_v1) + time_v1_v2 + time_v2_v3 + time_vl_s1),
  data = pat_df_vl_selected_l$men, family = Gamma(link = "log"),
  warmup = 1000, iter = 3000, chains = 1,
  init = 0, control = list(adapt_delta = 0.95))

#saveRDS(play_mod, glue("{dirs$outputs}/play_mod_doubleinteraction.rds"))
conditional_effects(play_mod)

play_mod
```
